title: OCEANBOOST LF named Sustainable Ingredient of the Year at the European Natural Beauty Awards
summary: For Origin by Ocean, the award adds another independent proof point for an approach we have been building deliberately: transforming invasive marine biomass into high-performance ingredients that can compete on what matters to customers: functionality, efficacy and sustainability
